For the full year, the company reported sales was PKR 11.54 million compared to PKR 11.78 million a year ago. Net income was PKR 277.53 million compared to net loss of PKR 125.25 million a year ago. Basic earnings per share from continuing operations was PKR 69.38 compared to basic loss per share from continuing operations of PKR 31.31 a year ago. © S&P Capital IQ -

Period Day Week ARPAK: Dynamic Chart Company Profile Arpak International Investments Limited is engaged in the investment business of various forms. The Company's investment business includes dealing in agricultural commodities as well as industrial, including sugar, rice, molasses, vegetable oils, cotton, polypropylene products and similar other products; purchasing, taking on leasing or otherwise acquiring for the purpose of development and sale of any estate and land, building, easement or other interest in real estate; selling or disposing off the undertakings of the Company or any part thereof for such consideration as the Company may think fit and in particular shares; acquiring and disposing off or to otherwise taking over, undertaking and carrying on, wholly or in part for shares or cash; taking part in the management, and managing and acting as consultant and advisor to the business of other companies on fee and commission; and investing funds of the companies in shares, stocks, bonds, commercial papers, debentures and others.
